scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Cal Poly Pomona Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 first-year class, C1): 48,258 applied, 35,688 admitted (74.0%), 4,004 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 393 applied, 193 admitted, 13 enrolled. No early decision or early action. Waiting list: 1,152 qualified applicants were offered a place, 596 accepted it and 58 were admitted. Cal Poly Pomona is not impacted at the campus level for first-years but 19 programs are impacted, so the campus-wide admit rate overstates the odds for those majors. SAT/ACT are not used in admission (test-blind): the Common Data Set's C9 test-score tables are blank and IPEDS (fall 2024) lists no SAT/ACT ranges, so none are shown. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column. Undergraduate enrollment (25,312) and the nonresident count (289) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set C8A: Cal Poly Pomona does not use SAT/ACT in admission; C8F says scores are 'no longer considered for admissions starting Fall 2021'.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 for 2026-27: tuition $6,838 (in-state) and $20,968 (nonresident = $6,838 plus 30 units at $471), required fees $1,727.94 (shown rounded), on-campus food and housing $16,909 (housing $11,309 + meal plan $5,600). The CDS ticks '2026-27 costs not available' (expected 06/2026), but the same figures appear on Cal Poly Pomona's 2026-27 budget page dated Feb. 9, 2026. Estimated expenses for residents: books $1,112, transportation $1,896, other $2,778 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Common Data Set H6: institutional scholarship or grant aid is not available to degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates
